title: Elysium Fire (The Prefect Dreyfus Emergencies Book 2)
author: Alastair Reynolds

highlights.text: The worlds coexisted in peace, for the most part. The people were as grudgingly content as the truly free will ever be. Wealth and power were in almost limitless abundance. Matter and energy danced to human whims. Even death itself was in slow, stubborn retreat.
“It’s no good arguing with them,” someone muttered. “They’ve got a justification for everything. They could murder us all and still say it was in the shining name of democracy.”
“If you don’t like democracy,” Thalia said, “then you’re in the wrong solar system.”
“Be grateful you’ll never need our intervention,” Thalia said. “But if you did, you’d still have it. You don’t have to like us to count on us.”

“Utopia is stifling. What’s the point in longevity if every day is a grey duplicate of the one before?” “Life is still precious,” Dreyfus said. “Still worth cherishing. No matter how it looks most of the time.”
“We are all trying to do our best,” Aumonier said. “We are. It’s just that some of us are doing a better job of it than others.”

For all its flaws, for all its imperfections, for all that it still contained little knots of darkness and cruelty, she believed there were infinitely worse ways to live. It was not such a bad thing, this endlessly circling river of light and lives.
I can read you like a book. A very simple book containing mostly pictures.”
